svg.title: A waiting task holds no worker
svg.desc: An agent asks to wait. The runtime stores its checkpoint and wake-up in one transaction and frees the worker. When the timer is due the wake-up service queues a new activation, and the handler resumes from the checkpoint. First activation: 1. Runtime calls Agent handler: handle(activation 1). 2. Agent handler replies to Runtime: waiting + checkpoint. Dormant: 3. Runtime calls Store: checkpoint + wake-up. 4. Store replies to Runtime: committed. Timer due: 5. Wake-up service calls Store: fire due wake-up (queue execution). 6. Runtime calls Store: find due executions. 7. Store replies to Runtime: queued execution. Second activation: 8. Runtime calls Agent handler: handle(activation 2). 9. Agent handler replies to Runtime: completed + output.
